description.value: You understand the power of waiting for the opportune moment. When you would roll initiative, you can choose to forgo rolling and instead receive a result of 1. If you do, you are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Quickened] during the first round of combat. You can use the extra action only to Stride or to Strike.
